text:
maria: Quick sync re: visibility launch. Weve got three big customer asks: per-route cost, trace sampling hooks, and error-slice analytics. We can realistically ship two for GA.
jasper: Infra update: trace hooks require ingestion + a new storage index; estimate ~2 sprints. Per-route cost is lighter: aggregation job + UI tagging. Error-slices need sampled event indexing and a query API work.
kevin: Sales note: one E-lead wants per-route cost + audit logs before contract sign. Dropping cost risks the deal.
olivia: UX asks for 3 dashboard templates (default, cost, errors) and a drilldown flow that links errors -> traces. If we only do basic cost, we can include placeholder drilldowns for GA.
sophie: Product proposal: GA = dashboards + per-route cost (top routes) + enterprise audit logs with pseudonymized IDs. Trace hooks as opt-in beta behind FF. Defer full error analytics to 1.1.
maria: Acceptance criteria attempt: (1) per-route cost surfaced for top 10 routes, within 10% of billing; (2) audit logs available for enterprise customers, retained per policy; (3) trace hooks feature-flagged and documented as beta; (4) no p95 latency regression >5%.
jasper: Perf caveat: telemetry pipeline currently has ~15% headroom; synchronous sampling would hurt tail latency. Plan async sampling buffer + backpressure. Add infra tickets: trace-hook-loadtest, cost-aggregation-smoke, billing-alignment-check.
kevin: For GA tagging, limit to: service, route, enterprise_billing. Legal says pseudonymized customer_id ok for audit logs in staging. Sales wants a billing sign-off gate.
olivia: UX tasks: build 3 templates, wire cost tile, mock the error drilldown with a See traces link. If trace hooks not ready, have the link point to sample traces.
sophie: Security flagged KMS integration for audit blobs in private deployments. Add acceptance task: audit-logs + KMS verified in staging.
jenkins-bot: CI: visibility-gamma branch -> canary at 1764310200. Tests: telemetry-smoke, cost-regression-suite, audit-retention-check.
maria: Decision summary: GA scope = dashboards (templates + per-route cost for top routes) + enterprise audit logs with pseudonymized IDs; trace hooks -> opt-in beta; error-slices -> 1.1. Owners: jasper (infra), olivia (UX), sophie (product eng).
sophie: I'll post acceptance checklist in the roadmap doc (include test prompts, cost accuracy targets, SLO verification, FF controls).
kevin: I'll notify sales + the enterprise lead and attach the billing alignment ask.
maria: Follow-up: quick sync tomorrow 10am to confirm ticket estimates. :thumbsup:
